## Diagnose logs

```{r}
source("fbd.R")
#n = 99
n = 10
diag_table = NULL
for(i in 0:n){
    attempt <- tryCatch({
    # Load data    
    ### Data first
    raw <- readLines(paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/sequences_", i, ".nex", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    # and now clean the names to avoid issues with nexus reading
    clean_raw <- gsub("ms\\_|[|]\\S*", "", raw)
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".nex")
    writeLines(clean_raw, tmp)
    data <- ape::read.nexus.data(tmp)
    # Give ML the same exact data as BI
    k   <- max(suppressWarnings(as.integer(unlist(data))), na.rm = TRUE) + 1
    d_k <- phyDat(data, type = "USER", levels = 0:(k - 1), ambiguity = NA)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
    
    diag_table = rbind(diag_table, bi_diagnostics(i, burnin = 0.1, d_k))
}
diag_table
write.csv(diag_table, file = "diag_table.csv")
```
.
```{r}
boxplot(diag_table[,"ml_diff"], main = "ML log-likelihood - BI mean likelihood", sub=" (burnin 10%)")

ggplot(data = res) +

  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "ML LLk - BI mean Lk (topo)", y = topology_cost)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "BI mean Lk (topo) - BI mean Lk", y = branchlen_cost)) 
  ylab("Likelihood differences") +
  ggtitle("Topology vs branch length", subtitle =  "(local agreements/families)")
```


```{r}
diag <- read.csv("diag_table.csv")[, -1]
names(diag) <- c("tradition", "mean_lik", "ess_post", "ess_lik", "ess_height", "sa_count", "ML_diff")
m <- merge(subset(results, method == "FBD_MCC"), diag, by = "tradition")
m$mixed <- pmin(m$ess_post, m$ess_lik, m$ess_height) >= 200
aggregate(cid ~ mixed, m, median)
aggregate(cid ~ I(sa_count > 0.5), m, median)
```

## Our templates vs Beauti

```{r}
beast_bin <- paste(beast_bin_folder, "beast", sep="")
for(i in (0)){
  # Run our version
  out = paste(
    "comp_beast_vs_ourtemplate/ourtemplate/sequences_", i,
    sep = "")

  system2(
    command = beast_bin, 
    args = c(
      "-overwrite -seed 42 -prefix",
      "comp_beast_vs_ourtemplate/ourtemplate/", 
      paste("comp_beast_vs_ourtemplate/ourtemplate/sequences_", i, ".xml", sep="")
      ), 
    stdout = paste(out, ".txt", sep=""), stderr = paste(out, ".txt", sep="")
    )
  
  treeannotator_bin <- paste(beast_bin_folder, "treeannotator", sep="")
  tree_file <- paste(out, ".trees", sep="")
  
  system2(command = treeannotator_bin, 
          args = c("-burnin 10 -height median", tree_file, "mcc_tree.tree"),
          stdout = FALSE)
  # Read the MCC tree with annotations preserved
  mcc_tree <- read.nexus("mcc_tree.tree")
  
  # Run Beauti version
  out = paste(
    "comp_beast_vs_ourtemplate/beauti_gen/sequences_", i,
    sep = "")

  system2(
    command = beast_bin, 
    args = c(
      "-overwrite -seed 42 -prefix",
      "comp_beast_vs_ourtemplate/beauti_gen/", 
      paste("comp_beast_vs_ourtemplate/beauti_gen/sequences_", i, ".xml", sep="")
      ), 
    stdout = paste(out, ".txt", sep=""), stderr = paste(out, ".txt", sep="")
    )
  
  treeannotator_bin <- paste(beast_bin_folder, "treeannotator", sep="")
  tree_file <- paste(out, ".trees", sep="")
  
  system2(command = treeannotator_bin, 
          args = c("-burnin 10 -height median", tree_file, "mcc_tree.tree"),
          stdout = FALSE)
  # Read the MCC tree with annotations preserved
  mcc_tree <- read.nexus("mcc_tree.tree")
  
}

```

## Check failures SOLVED

```{r benchmark_pestimate, echo=FALSE}
failures = c(8, 10, 16, 20)
#n = 99
#n = 20
#for(i in 0:n){
for(i in failures){
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    raw <- readLines(paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/sequences_", i, ".nex", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    matches <- regmatches(raw, regexec("ms_([0-9]+)\\|([0-9]+)", raw))
    matched_matrix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(matches, function(x) if(length(x) == 3) x[2:3] else NULL))
    dates_vector <- setNames(as.numeric(matched_matrix[,2]), matched_matrix[,1])
    clean_raw <- gsub("ms\\_|[|]\\S*", "", raw)
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".nex")
    writeLines(clean_raw, tmp)
    data <- ape::read.nexus.data(tmp)
    unlink(tmp)
    data = phyDat(data, type = "USER", levels = 0:10, ambiguity=NA)
    gt_raw = readLines(con = paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/tree_", i, ".newick", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    gt <- convert_gt_internal_nodes(gt_raw)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
  # Perform analyses

  BI = fbd(data,
           dates_vector,
           nj_init = FALSE,
           template_file =
             #"beast_templates/BDSKY_serial.xml",
             "beast_templates/FBD_NJinit_serial.xml",
           out = 
             paste("rbeast_out/", "sequences_", i, sep=""),
           chain_length=1000000, 
           bin_folder = beast_bin_folder)
  
  if(!is.null(BI)){
    # save objects to disk
    write.tree(BI$mrc_tree, file=paste("rbeast_out/mrc_", i, ".tree", sep=""))
    write.tree(BI$mcc_tree, file=paste("rbeast_out/mcc_", i, ".tree", sep=""))
  }
  # save objects to disk
  write.tree(fit_opt$tree, file=paste("ml_out/", i, ".tree", sep=""))
  
}
```
